sources.facts: The operator identifies Tōkai as Japan’s first commercial station and records the 25 July 1966 opening.
The historical chronology records construction of the separate second station in 1973.
Official report records the original height of the historic exterior chimney at approximately 89 m, before reduction.
The U.S. Department of Energy’s archive lists HD.15.058 as United States government work. The picture’s archive upload date is separate from the undated historic scene.
